prompt: Which plan lets each caller collect at the station where the umbrella was found if the guide allows it?
promptZh: 哪個安排能讓來電者在流程允許時，到撿到雨傘的原車站領取？

options.text: Arrange collection of both umbrellas at the stations where they were found.
options.zh: 安排兩把傘都在各自被撿到的車站領取。
options.whyZh: 兩人都提供了未公開的辨識細節，但橡樹巷站明早沒有售票窗口人員，不可安排在該站領傘。

options.text: Arrange collection of both umbrellas at the depot.
options.zh: 安排兩把傘都在保管所領取。
options.whyZh: 橡樹巷站那把須在保管所領取；雲雀街站那把已核對未公開的修補細節，且窗口早上仍有人值班，不必送保管所。

options.text: Offer collection at Lark Street after its window opens, and send the other claimant to the depot.
options.zh: 請本站失主在雲雀街站窗口開放後領取，另一位失主則到保管所領取。
options.whyZh: 兩位失主都說出了未公開的細節，但只有雲雀街站隔天早上有窗口值班。代回覆橡樹巷站的信箱不等於代為保管。

options.text: Offer collection of both umbrellas at Lark Street after its window opens.
options.zh: 請兩位失主都在雲雀街站窗口開放後領取。
options.whyZh: 雲雀街站只代回覆橡樹巷站的信箱，不代保管該站失物；該站的雨傘應在保管所領取。

explanationZh: 兩位失主都說出了未公開的細節，但只有雲雀街站隔天早上有窗口值班。代回覆橡樹巷站的信箱不等於代為保管。

vocabulary.note: 例如傘把下未刊在公告上的修補痕跡；能用來核對物件是否屬於來認領的人。

evidence: A station sends ordinary items to the central depot on the evening collection. A confirmed claimant can instead collect an item at that station the next day, but only if the claimant gave a distinguishing detail not shown on its public listing and the station has a staffed ticket window the next morning. If the window will be closed, mark the item for collection at the depot; do not arrange a handover at the station even if the claimant has been identified. / The ticket window will open at 9:00 tomorrow, an hour late because the glass is being replaced. Leon will staff it from opening. The team at Oak Lane will have no one on its ticket window tomorrow morning; they've asked us to answer their property inbox, not to take custody of anything for them. / Two callers asked about umbrellas. The one found here has an orange band, as shown online. Its caller mentioned a stitched repair under the handle that wasn’t included in the listing. I checked that detail. Oak Lane's caller described a bent tip on their umbrella before it was listed at all, and Oak Lane checked that detail. Both callers said they could come in the morning.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: A station sends ordinary items to the central depot on the evening collection. A confirmed claimant can instead collect an item at that station the next day, but only if the claimant gave a distinguishing detail not shown on its public listing and the station has a staffed ticket window the next morning. If the window will be closed, mark the item for collection at the depot; do not arrange a handover at the station even if the claimant has been identified.

The ticket window will open at 9:00 tomorrow, an hour late because the glass is being replaced. Leon will staff it from opening. The team at Oak Lane will have no one on its ticket window tomorrow morning; they've asked us to answer their property inbox, not to take custody of anything for them.

Two callers asked about umbrellas. The one found here has an orange band, as shown online. Its caller mentioned a stitched repair under the handle that wasn’t included in the listing. I checked that detail. Oak Lane's caller described a bent tip on their umbrella before it was listed at all, and Oak Lane checked that detail. Both callers said they could come in the morning.
